title: Nuka Vending Machine
description: A weathered red Nuka vending machine stands in the foreground with glowing purple, pink, and green bottle icons on its display. To the right, a low-poly robotic character in red and blue sits on a crate, surrounded by peeling purple and yellow posters on a decaying wall under dim fluorescent lighting.
prompt: A retro-futuristic post-apocalyptic scene featuring a worn red Nuka vending machine with glowing purple, pink, and green bottle symbols, positioned next to a low-poly blue and red robot sitting on a crate. The background shows a decaying wall covered in torn purple and yellow posters with visible text fragments like RANGES and NUK. Dim overhead fluorescent lighting, dusty atmosphere, stylized digital painting aesthetic.
